name: Nolt
tagline: The core loop is small enough for a capable coding agent to produce a useful local version in one sitting. For Nolt, publish a feedback board with voting, comments, statuses, and a roadmap. The hard boundary is hosted simplicity, custom domains, integrations, and low maintenance, plus participant network, synthesis workflow, and collaboration.
